# Caption

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Caption")`

The text of what a sound says: a line of dialogue, or a description such as "[a door creaks]". Parent it to its `Sound`. While that sound plays and can be heard on a machine, the caption is current there: `DialogueService:GetCaptions` lists it, and `CaptionStarted` and `CaptionEnded` fire for it. A sound on a part can be heard within `RollOffMaxDistance` of the listener; the player's volume settings are not considered.

`Text` and `Speaker` are localization keys, not text. They are looked up in the game's catalogs with `LocalizationService:Translate`, so a caption is shown in each player's own language, which can differ from the language that player hears.

A sound that has a caption but no file in any language is silent and lasts as long as its caption: `Seconds`, or a reading time for the text. Dialogue can therefore be written and played as text before it is recorded. In a multiplayer match, a caption replicates with its sound.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The color the speaker's name is shown in. |
| `Seconds` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How long the sound lasts when it has no file in any language, in seconds. At 0 a reading time is used: 1.5 seconds plus 0.06 seconds for each character of the text in the project's default language, up to 12 seconds, the same on every machine. It is ignored for a sound that has a file. |
| `Speaker` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The localization key of the speaker's name. Leave it empty for a sound with no speaker. |
| `Text` | `string` | `""` | read/write | The localization key of the text that is said. If no catalog has the key, the key itself is shown. |
